name: Yao An Deng Hai
source:
Lu Feihe is a protagonist who, despite lacking any innate talent, yearns to become a master of supernatural beings.

She forces the initiation of a pact ritual, summoning a yokai servant of her very own.

To everyone’s astonishment, the being she summons is Yuan Zhi—the most powerful and gifted cat-yokai to appear in Crescent City in nearly a thousand years.

Following this, under the direction of the city elders, she begins investigating the mysterious, successive disappearances of yokai throughout the city, all while racing against time to avert an impending, cataclysmic disaster.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2941280/]Steam[/url]]
